verdict.rationale: HeyGen lists its own integrations with n8n, Make, HubSpot and Zapier, which let users wire video generation into automated workflows. Its batch APIs with webhooks support asynchronous, background-style processing, and the Video Agent can 'handle the rest' once given a style. However, the evidence shows no native automation builder, scheduler, or trigger system inside HeyGen itself, so autonomous background runs depend on external orchestrators or developer code. Missing for 10: a native automation, scheduling or trigger feature; documentation of background runs without external tools; hands-on or independent corroboration.
